summary: Tested the new 'type your own job title, skip quiz' custom roadmap feature. Backend: wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter17_custom_path.py (7 tests, all passed when run serially with -n 0 — this file must NOT be run under pytest-xdist's parallel/loadscope mode because it has a stateful sequential dependency across classes on the same user account; see note below). Verified POST /api/roadmap/custom happy path without qualifications (status pending -> polled to ready, >=2 milestones with 1+ tasks each, titles relevant to 'Grafik komputerowy'), happy path WITH qualifications text ('Projektant UX'), duplicate-title case-insensitive reactivation (returns existing:true, does NOT create a second path, re-activates the same path_id), 422 on empty/1-char/whitespace-only title, and 403 with Polish message when hitting PREMIUM_PATH_LIMIT=3. Frontend (Playwright, 375x667): verified web preview renders real visible content (NOT a blank white screen as the previous testing attempt reported — landing/auth page, quiz, home, road all rendered with real content in every screenshot taken this session; Metro logs show no fatal errors, only a benign expo-router font ENOENT warning). Verified all 3 new entry points: (1) Home tab 'none' state (seeded via direct-mongo profile-without-recommendations doc since this state isn't reachable through normal quiz completion, which always auto-calls /recommendations/generate) shows the 'albo' divider + 'Masz już konkretny cel?' + ghost 'Wpisz stanowisko' button, navigates to /custom-path; (2) Road tab chip row ('road-add-custom-path' dashed chip) visible next to 'Dodaj ścieżkę', navigates correctly; (3) did not re-verify the Road-tab EMPTY-state button ('road-go-custom-path') directly via UI click but confirmed its testID/onPress wiring via code review (identical pattern to the other two, which both worked). Full end-to-end flow verified: typed title + qualifications -> tapped submit -> mandatory ad-gate modal appeared ('ad-modal'/'REKLAMA') -> tapped 'Obejrzyj reklamę' -> mocked countdown -> 'Dziękujemy za obejrzenie reklamy!' thanks screen -> tapped 'Super, kontynuuj' -> celebration modal appeared with correct Polish text 'Świetny wybór! Buduję Twoją drogę do celu: TEST_Grafik komputerowy' -> auto-navigated to Road tab after ~2s showing 'Buduję Twoją drogę...' pending state -> after ~50s polling, roadmap reached ready with realistic, highly relevant Polish milestones (Kurs Adobe Photoshop, Nauka Adobe Illustrator, typografia, Adobe InDesign/DTP, Figma, motion design w After Effects, etc. for 'Grafik komputerowy'). Regression check passed: 'Dodaj ścieżkę' chip in Road tab still correctly navigates back to Home tab (Zawody) as before.
action_items: No functional bugs found. The reporter's earlier 'blank white screenshot' observation did not reproduce in this session — web preview rendered real content consistently across ~10 separate screenshots (landing, auth, quiz, home 'none' state, custom-path screen, ad modal, celebration modal, road tab with ready roadmap). Consider it a transient/local tooling issue on the reporter's end rather than an app regression, but worth a quick independent re-check if it recurs.

Low priority / test-infra only: /app/backend/tests/test_iter17_custom_path.py has module-scoped, order-dependent fixtures across its 3 test classes (creates 2 paths in class 1, asserts count in class 2/3) and MUST be run with `pytest -n 0` (or otherwise forced single-worker) — running it under this repo's default pytest.ini xdist/loadscope config splits classes across workers and causes false failures due to races on the same shared test account. Not a product bug, just document this constraint for future runs of this file.
critical_code_review_comments: choose_custom_path (POST /api/roadmap/custom) correctly mirrors choose_path's dedup/limit/spawn logic almost line-for-line (case-insensitive title match for reactivation, PREMIUM_PATH_LIMIT check, same run_roadmap background task) — good reuse, low risk of divergent behavior between quiz-based and custom-typed paths.

CustomPathIn Pydantic model enforces min_length=2 on title which cleanly produces the required 422 without extra handler code; the belt-and-suspenders `if not title: raise HTTPException(400,...)` after `.strip()` inside the handler is dead code for blank input since Pydantic already rejects '' and whitespace-only strings of length>=2 would pass through un-stripped-checked — minor redundancy, not a bug (whitespace-only 2+ char titles like '  ' would pass Pydantic's min_length check since it doesn't strip, then get caught by the handler's own strip+empty check, so the redundant check is in fact load-bearing for that edge case — leaving as-is is fine).

Frontend custom-path.tsx reuses the exact same useAds().watchAd() + celebration-modal + queryClient.invalidateQueries pattern as career/[id].tsx, which is good consistency; router.dismissTo('/(tabs)/road') after the 2.2s timer works correctly even when custom-path.tsx was reached via router.push from multiple different origin screens (tested from both Home and Road tab chip).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passed, 0 bugs found

All TEST_-prefixed roadmap paths created on test_ui_fresh@test.pl during backend+frontend testing were deleted via DELETE /api/paths/{id} at the end of this session; account paths list verified empty afterward.
